task: Single-board stationary visual inspection on the public VisA pcb1 benchmark (normal-only anomaly detection)
domainNote: Benchmark task only. Not validated on motorcycle components or any customer production line.

modelSelection.method: validation image AUROC with a 300-image bank; test split unused

memoryBank.source: VisA pcb1 bank split (804 normal images), 16000-patch greedy coreset

officialSplit.note: Official VisA 1cls test split (threshold-free). Memory bank excludes the 100 validation normals held out from the official train split.

scenarios.note: Synthetic capture faults applied to real test images, plus real images of other VisA objects.

latency.method: time.perf_counter around each stage inside InspectionPipeline.inspect; sequential, single process, CPU only; first inspection excluded and reported separately
